name: edge-can-sidecar

compatibility.rule: Rebuild the sidecar from the matching package source. The npm package does not bundle platform binaries.

qualified: Linux SocketCAN/vcan with classic CAN 2.0A/B frames
source build on the target platform
unqualified: CAN FD (FDF/BRS/ESI) and payloads over 8 bytes
physical CAN controllers and injected bus-off on hardware
hot upgrade or rolling sidecar replacement
multiple clients owning one interface concurrently
